text:
Mike Chen: Heads-up — planning a go/no-go sync for the upcoming cut. Proposed slot: Mon Apr 6 2026 16:00 PT. We need: stakeholder RSVP, any blocking issues, and owners for smoke/canary. Draft agenda below. Please respond with RSVP + any blockers by EOD Fri.

Ravi Patel: I can be incident owner if anything pops during canary. 16:00 works for me.

Jordan Lee: I'm OOO that afternoon. If we can move earlier (15:00) I can join, otherwise I'll prep handoff notes and a checklist.

Priya Nair: 15:00 is rough for me. 16:00 OK. I'll own DB migration verification and schema rollbacks.

Sara Gomez: +1 for 16:00. Infra oncall can join at start and then standby. I'll ping eng-oncall once final.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach runbook, add alert-channel, and ensure SLO owners are listed.

Mike Chen: Updated draft agenda (please copy+paste to your calendars and add owners):

```
1) Quick rollcall (5m) — attendees confirm ready states
2) Blockers review (10m) — each owner calls out must-fix vs known issues
3) Canary plan (10m) — scope, duration, success criteria, rollback trigger
4) Smoke tests (5m) — who runs, required checks (auth, DB, L7 checks)
5) Deployment timeline & cutover (5m) — expected duration, downtime windows
6) Escalation & post-cut monitoring (5m) — alert channels, oncall owners
7) Final decision and fallback (5m)

Notes: add links to runbook, release PR, perf dashboard, and issue tracker.
```

Mike Chen: Quick RSVP list so far: Ravi (incident owner), Priya (DB owner), Sara (infra liaison), Jordan (SDK/compat notes — will be standby). Add any other stakeholders (security, legal, partner ops) here.

Ravi Patel: Blocking item: quantization perf tests failing for p95 on A100 clusters. Filed issue #4321 and running targeted repro. Will update status by Fri 12:00 PT. If not fixed, recommend delaying canary or narrowing scope.

Jordan Lee: Can we extend the canary window to 2 hours? Client-side SDK compatibility tests can take longer to validate at scale.

Priya Nair: +1 for 2h canary if infra can reserve capacity. Also need a DB shadow-run owner for the first 30m.

Sara Gomez: We can reserve Dedicated seats for a 2h window but need commit by Friday AM. I'll check availability and confirm.

Mike Chen: ACTIONS:
- Ravi: status on #4321 by Fri 12:00 PT (blocker?)
- Sara: confirm Dedicated seat reservation by Fri 10:30 PT
- Priya: post DB smoke checklist to thread by Fri 15:00 PT
- Jordan: upload SDK compatibility summary by Fri 15:00 PT
- Mike: publish preflight doc and poll (quick availability poll) — link will be posted here tomorrow

Sara Gomez: pinging ops-bot to add runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-2026-04-06

ops-bot: Runbook link added to thread. Also created checklist template and attached alert playbook.

Mike Chen: Thanks — if anyone else needs to be invited (security, partner-ops, cust-eng), add them here. Final reminder: RSVP + blockers by EOD Fri. I'll post the final agenda and calendar invite tomorrow morning.
